paper_id: Towards Higher Pareto Frontier in Multilingual Machine Translation__oa_W4385571797
title: Towards Higher Pareto Frontier in Multilingual Machine Translation
motivation: 现有方法只能trade-off在Pareto frontier上平衡多语言性能，无法同时提升所有语言
problem_framing: 多语言NMT的数据长尾分布导致优化某些语言必然损害其他语言，形成Pareto优化困境
key_insight: 用不同采样分布训练两个模型形成不同Pareto解，通过mutual distillation让各自学习对方的优势，从而把边界向外推
method_signature: Pareto-MD: 双模型协作训练 + 不同温度采样分布 + 语言对特定蒸馏权重
evaluation_criteria: BLEU score提升量和Pareto frontier可视化位移
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 训练两个模型使计算成本翻倍；O2M场景下模型1在HRL上会退化
evidence_for_taste: pushing the Pareto frontier outwards rather than making trade-offs
address shortcomings of individual Pareto optimal solutions
the worse model is also possible to improve the better model
The optimal value of distillation weight varies across different datasets
the performance of HRLs (i.e., fr and de) drops about 0.7 BLEU
thinking_moves: 把Pareto优化问题从单模型内部trade-off转为多模型协作外推边界
假设'更差的模型也有独特特征可补足更好的模型'，然后实验验证BI-PMD > UNI-PMD
发现手动调alpha的三个缺陷（语言适应性/动态性/通用性），设计AUTO-PMD自动搜索
先理论证明搜索空间降维的合理性，再做实验验证
